summary: Ribbon Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company listed on Nasdaq under RIBB/RIBBU/RIBBR, filed an 8-K reporting an August 11, 2026 deposit of $125,000 into its trust account to fund a one-month extension of its initial business combination deadline from September 15, 2026 to October 15, 2026. No target, price, or premium was disclosed, and no advisor or board recommendation was named. This is the eleventh-hour SPAC extension mechanics: the sponsor-funded payment buys time without a shareholder vote. Watch for redemption pressure, trust balance erosion, and whether a definitive deal or liquidation follows before October 15.
